faces.f: "Are you my mummy?"
"Silence will fall."
"You see, before you reactivated it, I reversed the polarity of the neutron flow."
"They may have superior numbers, but we have superior minds."
"Time to say goodbye."

"Know thine enemy. Admirable advice."
—The Fourth Doctor

n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

faces.f: "People assume time is a strict progression of cause to effect, but actually, from a non-linear, non-subjective viewpoint, it's more like a big ball of wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey stuff."
"Elevate."
"Find the Doctor! Seek, locate, destroy!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Target player mills two cards, then exiles their graveyard.
III — Put all creature cards exiled with this enchantment onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.

faces.f: "You are the enemy of the Daleks! You will be exterminated! Exterminate!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace for each lore counter on Genesis of the Daleks.
IV — Target opponent faces a villainous choice — Destroy all Dalek creatures and each of your opponents loses life equal to the total power of Daleks that died this turn, or destroy all non-Dalek creatures.

faces.f: "There's a gravestone here for someone with the same name as me."
"Hey, who turned out the lights?"
"What's your plan? Some clever sciencey-spacey thing I won't understand?"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II, III — Choose a creature card name, then goad all creatures with a name chosen for this enchantment. (Until your next turn, they attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)

faces.f:
"We try, it doesn't work, we try again. We learn, we improve, we fail again, but better."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"You will be deleted."
"Try to see what I see. We are so lucky we are still alive to see this beautiful world."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after VI.)
I — This Saga deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
II, III, IV, V — Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
VI — Add six {R}.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Exile the top five cards of your library. For each nonland card exiled this way, put a number of time counters on that card equal to its mana value. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
II — Time travel, then time travel.
III — For each opponent, destroy up to one target artifact that player controls.

faces.f:
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back."
—The Twelfth Doctor
"Wicked!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after VI.)
I — Create a Treasure token.
II, III, IV, V, VI — Create a token that's a copy of target non-Saga token you control.

faces.f:
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen."
—The Third Doctor

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 white Human creature token with ward {2} and a 4/4 white Alien Rhino creature token.
II — Investigate.
III — You may exile a Human you control and an artifact you control. If you do, search your library for a Doctor card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

faces.f: "Now, I always come prepared."
"Creag an tuire!"
"Look, Doctor, good marksmanship is not a matter of luck."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Create a 2/2 green Alien Salamander creature token with islandwalk. (It can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.)
III — Until end of turn, whenever a Salamander deals combat damage to a player, it deals that much damage to target creature that player controls.

faces.f: "We honor the lost as we cannot honor our own."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, III — Choose target creature. Its owner shuffles it into their library, then investigates. (They create a Clue token.)
II, IV — Create a 2/2 black Alien Angel artifact creature token with first strike, vigilance, and "Whenever an opponent casts a creature spell, this token isn't a creature until end of turn."

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — For each player, destroy up to one target creature that player controls. For each creature destroyed this way, its controller creates a 3/3 green Mutant creature token with deathtouch.
II — Target nontoken creature becomes a 6/6 legendary Horror creature named Fenric and loses all abilities.
III — Target Mutant fights another target creature named Fenric.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a legendary card. You may play that card for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield. Put the rest of those exiled cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
IV — Choose up to three Doctors. You may exile all other creatures. If you do, this Saga deals 13 damage to you.

faces.f: "Physician, heal thyself."
"You are not alone."
"When did you last have the pleasure of smelling a flower, watching a sunset, eating a well-prepared meal?"

"The great swarm is approaching. As humanity celebrates, so shall it end."
—The Great Intelligence

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Investigate.
III — This Saga deals 1 damage to each opponent. Then if an opponent has 0 or less life, draw seven cards. Otherwise, exile this Saga and you may cast it this turn.

faces.f: "Time to run again. Love the running."

"The Towers sang, and you cried."
—River Song
"A perfect army, right? Right? Oh, come in, my pretties!"
"Breaking news! I'm everyone. And everyone in the world is me!"
"Fantastic!"
"Well . . . it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved."
"Anyway, nothing to do with you surprises me anymore, Doctor."
"This is a situation that requires tact and finesse. Fortunately, I am blessed with both!"
"It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."
"The most damning is still to come. And when I have finished, this court will demand your life!"
"Obey or you will be destroyed."

"They are fast. Faster than you can believe. Don't turn your back, don't look away, and don't blink."
—The Tenth Doctor

"We can travel anywhere and everywhere in 'that old box,' as you call it. Regardless of space and time."
—The First Doctor
"I don't want to go."
"And I suppose, if it's one last chance to say it, Rose Tyler..."

"The time has come for you to change your appearance, Doctor, and begin your exile."
—High Council of the Time Lords

"So that's what it means to be a Doctor of War."
—The First Doctor
"It is returning through the dark. And then, Doctor? Oh, but then he will knock four times."
"I see what you see. It's beautiful!"
"Before that night I first saw you, I had a premonition. A succession of disconnected images. A stone angel. You. A blue box called a TARDIS."

"It's subtler than that. Any stronger and people would question it. But contained in that rhythm, in layers of code, Vote Saxon. Believe in me. Whispering to the world."
—The Tenth Doctor

"Five left. Every time you say no to me, I will throw another key down there. Do we understand each other?"
—Clara Oswald
"All it took was a little Time. And all for this, to get beyond any one universe, to find Division, to get revenge on those who imprisoned us so long ago. To take them all."
"They want to kill us," said Steadfast. "No, they want to help you. Killing you is just a side effect," replied the Doctor.
"It's good to know I haven't lost my touch," said the Master. "You deserve my best," replied Missy.

"I had to make them pay for what I discovered. They lied to us, the founding fathers of Gallifrey. Everything we were told was a lie."
—The Master

"I am the Doctor. I'm coming to find you, and I will never, ever stop."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"It's a juddering dimensional portal in a mirror in a Norwegian bedroom."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Do you recognize them? The Chagaskas. Your worst fears, my creativity."
—Zellin

"Love is a form of hope and, like hope, love abides in the face of everything."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Do you like the forest being in Trafalgar Square? I think it's lovely."
—Maebh

"Somewhere there's danger, somewhere there's injustice, and somewhere else the tea's getting cold. Come on, Ace, we've got work to do!"
—The Seventh Doctor

"Nine cries for help, nine distress signals, all coming from the same planet."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"I've come a long way for you!" exclaimed the Sixth Doctor. "Naturally. Don't expect any thanks," replied the Second Doctor.

"Oh, so you're my replacements. Huh. A dandy and a clown. Have you done anything?"
—The First Doctor

"It's like I'm breaking into a million pieces and there's only one thing I remember. I have to save the Doctor."
—Clara Oswald

"We're capable of the most incredible change. We can evolve while still staying true to who we are. We can honor who we've been and choose who we want to be next."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Goodbye, Davros. It hasn't been pleasant."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey. Nicked it off the Master in the Death Zone."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"This is the Source. This is what you're fighting over. A device to rejuvenate a planet's ecosystem."
—The Tenth Doctor

"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember."
—Clara Oswald

"Handles, I said, 'Put me on a ship.' I didn't say, 'Put me on a Dalek ship.'"
—The Eleventh Doctor

"The Eye of Harmony. Exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole. Time Lord engineering."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Bow ties are cool."
—The Eleventh Doctor
"Well? Isn't anyone going to ask what is it with the glasses?"

"This place has so many secrets to yield."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"We are the Legion of the Beast."

"Act as if you know their plan, and sometimes, if you're very lucky, they'll actually tell you it!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Oh, Doctor. Fooling you once was a joy, but fooling you twice the same way? It's a privilege."
—Madame Kovarian

"Sometimes my brilliance astonishes even me!"
—The Fourth Doctor
"How does the celery help?" asked Peri. "If the gas is present, the celery turns purple," replied the Doctor.

"Oh, it's only an old relic. Like me."
—Professor Yana

"Cheap and nasty time travel."
—Missy

"Look at the trees. Not a trace of foliage. The very bark stripped from the trunks. And the soil, barren."
—The Sixth Doctor

"Apalapucia, voted number two planet in the top ten greatest destinations for the discerning intergalactic traveler."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"I must have made quite an impression."
—The Fourth Doctor

"You traveled five miles in twelve years?!"
—The Tenth Doctor

"I was wrong. The trees are not your enemy. They're your shield."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"A thing that looks like a police box, standing in a junkyard... it can move anywhere in time and space?"
—Ian Chesterton

"Close down the gravitic anomalizer, fire up the helmic regulator. And finally, the hand brake. Ready?"
—The Tenth Doctor

"You are a time-space machine. You're a vehicle! I've never asked you to cheer me up with hologrammatic antlers!"
—The Twelfth Doctor
"It's like the Doctor's," said Peri. "But infinitely superior, as I am to that galactic philanthropist," replied the Master.

"The whole city is a machine to turn people into Cybermen. What do you think? Exciting, isn't it?"
—Missy

"They were placed, after death. These are tombs. Water tombs, some sort of fluid, anyway."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"By Silencio Lake. On the Plain of Sighs. An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead."
—Madame Kovarian

"The lighthouse where I grew up, my family home. Why am I seeing that now? I haven't thought about that for years."
—Ruth

"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?"
—Sabalom Glitz

"The Medusa Cascade. I came here when I was just a kid, ninety years old."
—The Tenth Doctor

"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all."
—Ramo

"Twenty-seven planets in perfect balance. Come on, that is gorgeous!"
—The Tenth Doctor
"Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.

"Whoever holds the Source controls the destiny of the planet."
—Cobb

"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang."
—Karvanista

"I love old things. They make me feel sad."
—Sally Sparrow

"On the fields of Trenzalore, he stood as protector both of his own people and his new home."
—Tasha Lem

"Now, take your meds, don't travel at night, and don't drink the water. In fact, don't even touch the water. This entire planet has been made cruel."
—Ilin

"We're on the Thames. The last great Frost Fair. 1814, February the 4th."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Too long I have stayed my hand. No more."
—The War Doctor

"Every hour of sunlight that feeds it makes the world darker, and the beast stronger."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Iceworld. A space trading colony on the dark side of the planet Svartos... I think there's something interesting going on there, Mel."
—The Seventh Doctor

"No, no, come on, Doc. This is where you jump in with a rational explanation. I mean, ghosts don't exist, right?"
—Graham O'Brien

"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected."
—Captain Adelaide Brooke

"The woman twice dead, and her final message. He was drawn to this place of peace and solitude that he might divine her meaning."
—The Abbott

"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

"It's the TARDIS. It's my home! Or, at least it has been for a considerable number of years."
—The Second Doctor

"Venezia. La Serenissima. Impossible city. Preposterous city."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Strictly speaking, it's the fifteenth New York since the original, so that makes it New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New York."
—The Tenth Doctor

"The sky's a burnt orange, with the Citadel enclosed in a mighty glass dome, shining under the twin suns."
—The Tenth Doctor

"We will drain the oceans and put the humans in chains."
—The Fisher King

"The first one to get to the site marked as the Ghost Monument will be crowned the winner and transported off this planet."
—Ilin

"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"All we have to do is open the doors and read the very first words in recorded history..."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"We'll be safe over there. Safe from the Cheetahs, and the Master."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Watch for the omens! I declare a new golden age of prosperity for all."
—The Captain

"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly."
—Robin Hood

"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die."
—River Song
"How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.

"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Solar tsunami. Came directly from your sun. A tidal wave of radiation. Big, big, big."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Look at all those diamonds. Poisoned by the sun. No one can ever touch them."
—Claude

"This is the day the Sun expands. Welcome to the end of the world."
—The Ninth Doctor

"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something."
—Bill Potts

"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?"
—The Twelfth Doctor

"It's my party, and all of me is invited."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"No one's called it Satellite Five in ages. It's the Game Station now."
—Lynda

"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri
"Mothership will maintain Earth geostationary orbit. All systems fully operational. Attack Squad Delta, prepare to enter transmat."
"Doctor, look at this extraordinary city down here!" exclaimed Ian. "The Aztecs. They knew how to build." replied the Doctor.

"The Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten. It's a holy site for the Sun Singers of Akhat."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss."
—Ida Scott
"All the world's a stage," said the Doctor. "Hmm. I might use that." pondered Shakespeare.

"There are no predatory animals on Deva Loka. No diseases, no adverse environmental factors."
—Todd

"Vortis is ours. We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it."
—Vrestin

"Whoa, far out! Are you quite sure this is the planet you aimed for?"
—Peri Brown

"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind."
—The Third Doctor

"We stand at a crossroads, Doctor, quite alone, with our backs to the wall."
—Winston Churchill

"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis
"There will be no sacrifice this afternoon, Doctor. Or ever again."
"Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

"Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!"
—The Ninth Doctor
"I can see every single atom of your existence, and I divide them."
"Wilfred, it's my honor. Better be quick. Three, two, one."
"I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"
"You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

II, III — For each non-Saga permanent, choose a counter on it. You may put an additional counter of that kind on that permanent.
IV — Search your library for a Doctor card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

II — Create a 2/2 white Horse creature token with "Doctors you control have horsemanship." (They can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.)
III — Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn, time travel.

I — Destroy all creatures.

IV — Starting with you, each player votes for innocent or guilty. If guilty gets more votes, the owner of each card exiled with this Saga puts that card on the bottom of their library.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I — Each player creates three tapped 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens. The tokens are goaded for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield.
II, III — Put a +1/+1 counter on each Warrior creature.
IV — You may exile a nontoken creature you control. When you do, exile all Warriors.

faces.n: All of History, All at Once

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II, III — Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Doctor card, a card with doctor's companion, or a Vehicle card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.f: "Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."
"I don't want to see more things. I want to see the things in front of me more clearly."

"Blink and you're dead."
—The Tenth Doctor

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Search your library for a Doctor card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
II — Create a Food token and a 1/1 white Human creature token with "Doctor spells you cast cost {1} less to cast."
III — Create a token that's a copy of target creature, except it's a legendary Alien named Prisoner Zero.

faces.f:
"We've found the missing people- they're in the walls!"
—The Twelfth Doctor
"Are you my mummy?"
"Silence will fall."
"You see, before you reactivated it, I reversed the polarity of the neutron flow."
"They may have superior numbers, but we have superior minds."
"Time to say goodbye."

"Know thine enemy. Admirable advice."
—The Fourth Doctor

n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

faces.f: "People assume time is a strict progression of cause to effect, but actually, from a non-linear, non-subjective viewpoint, it's more like a big ball of wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey stuff."
"Elevate."
"Find the Doctor! Seek, locate, destroy!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Target player mills two cards, then exiles their graveyard.
III — Put all creature cards exiled with this enchantment onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.

faces.f: "You are the enemy of the Daleks! You will be exterminated! Exterminate!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace for each lore counter on Genesis of the Daleks.
IV — Target opponent faces a villainous choice — Destroy all Dalek creatures and each of your opponents loses life equal to the total power of Daleks that died this turn, or destroy all non-Dalek creatures.

faces.f: "There's a gravestone here for someone with the same name as me."
"Hey, who turned out the lights?"
"What's your plan? Some clever sciencey-spacey thing I won't understand?"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II, III — Choose a creature card name, then goad all creatures with a name chosen for this enchantment. (Until your next turn, they attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)

faces.f:
"We try, it doesn't work, we try again. We learn, we improve, we fail again, but better."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"You will be deleted."
"Try to see what I see. We are so lucky we are still alive to see this beautiful world."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after VI.)
I — This Saga deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
II, III, IV, V — Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
VI — Add six {R}.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Exile the top five cards of your library. For each nonland card exiled this way, put a number of time counters on that card equal to its mana value. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
II — Time travel, then time travel.
III — For each opponent, destroy up to one target artifact that player controls.

faces.f:
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back."
—The Twelfth Doctor
"Wicked!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after VI.)
I — Create a Treasure token.
II, III, IV, V, VI — Create a token that's a copy of target non-Saga token you control.

faces.f:
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen."
—The Third Doctor

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 white Human creature token with ward {2} and a 4/4 white Alien Rhino creature token.
II — Investigate.
III — You may exile a Human you control and an artifact you control. If you do, search your library for a Doctor card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

faces.f: "Now, I always come prepared."
"Creag an tuire!"
"Look, Doctor, good marksmanship is not a matter of luck."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Create a 2/2 green Alien Salamander creature token with islandwalk. (It can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.)
III — Until end of turn, whenever a Salamander deals combat damage to a player, it deals that much damage to target creature that player controls.

faces.f: "We honor the lost as we cannot honor our own."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, III — Choose target creature. Its owner shuffles it into their library, then investigates. (They create a Clue token.)
II, IV — Create a 2/2 black Alien Angel artifact creature token with first strike, vigilance, and "Whenever an opponent casts a creature spell, this token isn't a creature until end of turn."

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — For each player, destroy up to one target creature that player controls. For each creature destroyed this way, its controller creates a 3/3 green Mutant creature token with deathtouch.
II — Target nontoken creature becomes a 6/6 legendary Horror creature named Fenric and loses all abilities.
III — Target Mutant fights another target creature named Fenric.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a legendary card. You may play that card for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield. Put the rest of those exiled cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
IV — Choose up to three Doctors. You may exile all other creatures. If you do, this Saga deals 13 damage to you.

faces.f: "Physician, heal thyself."
"You are not alone."
"When did you last have the pleasure of smelling a flower, watching a sunset, eating a well-prepared meal?"

"The great swarm is approaching. As humanity celebrates, so shall it end."
—The Great Intelligence

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Investigate.
III — This Saga deals 1 damage to each opponent. Then if an opponent has 0 or less life, draw seven cards. Otherwise, exile this Saga and you may cast it this turn.

faces.f: "Time to run again. Love the running."

"The Towers sang, and you cried."
—River Song
"A perfect army, right? Right? Oh, come in, my pretties!"
"Breaking news! I'm everyone. And everyone in the world is me!"
"Fantastic!"
"Well . . . it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved."
"Anyway, nothing to do with you surprises me anymore, Doctor."
"This is a situation that requires tact and finesse. Fortunately, I am blessed with both!"
"It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."
"The most damning is still to come. And when I have finished, this court will demand your life!"
"Obey or you will be destroyed."

"They are fast. Faster than you can believe. Don't turn your back, don't look away, and don't blink."
—The Tenth Doctor

"We can travel anywhere and everywhere in 'that old box,' as you call it. Regardless of space and time."
—The First Doctor
"I don't want to go."
"And I suppose, if it's one last chance to say it, Rose Tyler..."

"The time has come for you to change your appearance, Doctor, and begin your exile."
—High Council of the Time Lords

"So that's what it means to be a Doctor of War."
—The First Doctor
"It is returning through the dark. And then, Doctor? Oh, but then he will knock four times."
"I see what you see. It's beautiful!"
"Before that night I first saw you, I had a premonition. A succession of disconnected images. A stone angel. You. A blue box called a TARDIS."

"It's subtler than that. Any stronger and people would question it. But contained in that rhythm, in layers of code, Vote Saxon. Believe in me. Whispering to the world."
—The Tenth Doctor

"Five left. Every time you say no to me, I will throw another key down there. Do we understand each other?"
—Clara Oswald
"All it took was a little Time. And all for this, to get beyond any one universe, to find Division, to get revenge on those who imprisoned us so long ago. To take them all."
"They want to kill us," said Steadfast. "No, they want to help you. Killing you is just a side effect," replied the Doctor.
"It's good to know I haven't lost my touch," said the Master. "You deserve my best," replied Missy.

"I had to make them pay for what I discovered. They lied to us, the founding fathers of Gallifrey. Everything we were told was a lie."
—The Master

"I am the Doctor. I'm coming to find you, and I will never, ever stop."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"It's a juddering dimensional portal in a mirror in a Norwegian bedroom."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Do you recognize them? The Chagaskas. Your worst fears, my creativity."
—Zellin

"Love is a form of hope and, like hope, love abides in the face of everything."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Do you like the forest being in Trafalgar Square? I think it's lovely."
—Maebh

"Somewhere there's danger, somewhere there's injustice, and somewhere else the tea's getting cold. Come on, Ace, we've got work to do!"
—The Seventh Doctor

"Nine cries for help, nine distress signals, all coming from the same planet."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"I've come a long way for you!" exclaimed the Sixth Doctor. "Naturally. Don't expect any thanks," replied the Second Doctor.

"Oh, so you're my replacements. Huh. A dandy and a clown. Have you done anything?"
—The First Doctor

"It's like I'm breaking into a million pieces and there's only one thing I remember. I have to save the Doctor."
—Clara Oswald

"We're capable of the most incredible change. We can evolve while still staying true to who we are. We can honor who we've been and choose who we want to be next."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"Goodbye, Davros. It hasn't been pleasant."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey. Nicked it off the Master in the Death Zone."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"This is the Source. This is what you're fighting over. A device to rejuvenate a planet's ecosystem."
—The Tenth Doctor

"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember."
—Clara Oswald

"Handles, I said, 'Put me on a ship.' I didn't say, 'Put me on a Dalek ship.'"
—The Eleventh Doctor

"The Eye of Harmony. Exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole. Time Lord engineering."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Bow ties are cool."
—The Eleventh Doctor
"Well? Isn't anyone going to ask what is it with the glasses?"

"This place has so many secrets to yield."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
"We are the Legion of the Beast."

"Act as if you know their plan, and sometimes, if you're very lucky, they'll actually tell you it!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Oh, Doctor. Fooling you once was a joy, but fooling you twice the same way? It's a privilege."
—Madame Kovarian

"Sometimes my brilliance astonishes even me!"
—The Fourth Doctor
"How does the celery help?" asked Peri. "If the gas is present, the celery turns purple," replied the Doctor.

"Oh, it's only an old relic. Like me."
—Professor Yana

"Cheap and nasty time travel."
—Missy

"Look at the trees. Not a trace of foliage. The very bark stripped from the trunks. And the soil, barren."
—The Sixth Doctor

"Apalapucia, voted number two planet in the top ten greatest destinations for the discerning intergalactic traveler."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"I must have made quite an impression."
—The Fourth Doctor

"You traveled five miles in twelve years?!"
—The Tenth Doctor

"I was wrong. The trees are not your enemy. They're your shield."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"A thing that looks like a police box, standing in a junkyard... it can move anywhere in time and space?"
—Ian Chesterton

"Close down the gravitic anomalizer, fire up the helmic regulator. And finally, the hand brake. Ready?"
—The Tenth Doctor

"You are a time-space machine. You're a vehicle! I've never asked you to cheer me up with hologrammatic antlers!"
—The Twelfth Doctor
"It's like the Doctor's," said Peri. "But infinitely superior, as I am to that galactic philanthropist," replied the Master.

"The whole city is a machine to turn people into Cybermen. What do you think? Exciting, isn't it?"
—Missy

"They were placed, after death. These are tombs. Water tombs, some sort of fluid, anyway."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"By Silencio Lake. On the Plain of Sighs. An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead."
—Madame Kovarian

"The lighthouse where I grew up, my family home. Why am I seeing that now? I haven't thought about that for years."
—Ruth

"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?"
—Sabalom Glitz

"The Medusa Cascade. I came here when I was just a kid, ninety years old."
—The Tenth Doctor

"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all."
—Ramo

"Twenty-seven planets in perfect balance. Come on, that is gorgeous!"
—The Tenth Doctor
"Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.

"Whoever holds the Source controls the destiny of the planet."
—Cobb

"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang."
—Karvanista

"I love old things. They make me feel sad."
—Sally Sparrow

"On the fields of Trenzalore, he stood as protector both of his own people and his new home."
—Tasha Lem

"Now, take your meds, don't travel at night, and don't drink the water. In fact, don't even touch the water. This entire planet has been made cruel."
—Ilin

"We're on the Thames. The last great Frost Fair. 1814, February the 4th."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Too long I have stayed my hand. No more."
—The War Doctor

"Every hour of sunlight that feeds it makes the world darker, and the beast stronger."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Iceworld. A space trading colony on the dark side of the planet Svartos... I think there's something interesting going on there, Mel."
—The Seventh Doctor

"No, no, come on, Doc. This is where you jump in with a rational explanation. I mean, ghosts don't exist, right?"
—Graham O'Brien

"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected."
—Captain Adelaide Brooke

"The woman twice dead, and her final message. He was drawn to this place of peace and solitude that he might divine her meaning."
—The Abbott

"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

"It's the TARDIS. It's my home! Or, at least it has been for a considerable number of years."
—The Second Doctor

"Venezia. La Serenissima. Impossible city. Preposterous city."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Strictly speaking, it's the fifteenth New York since the original, so that makes it New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New York."
—The Tenth Doctor

"The sky's a burnt orange, with the Citadel enclosed in a mighty glass dome, shining under the twin suns."
—The Tenth Doctor

"We will drain the oceans and put the humans in chains."
—The Fisher King

"The first one to get to the site marked as the Ghost Monument will be crowned the winner and transported off this planet."
—Ilin

"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"All we have to do is open the doors and read the very first words in recorded history..."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"We'll be safe over there. Safe from the Cheetahs, and the Master."
—The Seventh Doctor

"Watch for the omens! I declare a new golden age of prosperity for all."
—The Captain

"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly."
—Robin Hood

"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die."
—River Song
"How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.

"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"Solar tsunami. Came directly from your sun. A tidal wave of radiation. Big, big, big."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Look at all those diamonds. Poisoned by the sun. No one can ever touch them."
—Claude

"This is the day the Sun expands. Welcome to the end of the world."
—The Ninth Doctor

"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something."
—Bill Potts

"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?"
—The Twelfth Doctor

"It's my party, and all of me is invited."
—The Twelfth Doctor

"No one's called it Satellite Five in ages. It's the Game Station now."
—Lynda

"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri
"Mothership will maintain Earth geostationary orbit. All systems fully operational. Attack Squad Delta, prepare to enter transmat."
"Doctor, look at this extraordinary city down here!" exclaimed Ian. "The Aztecs. They knew how to build." replied the Doctor.

"The Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten. It's a holy site for the Sun Singers of Akhat."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss."
—Ida Scott
"All the world's a stage," said the Doctor. "Hmm. I might use that." pondered Shakespeare.

"There are no predatory animals on Deva Loka. No diseases, no adverse environmental factors."
—Todd

"Vortis is ours. We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it."
—Vrestin

"Whoa, far out! Are you quite sure this is the planet you aimed for?"
—Peri Brown

"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind."
—The Third Doctor

"We stand at a crossroads, Doctor, quite alone, with our backs to the wall."
—Winston Churchill

"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis
"There will be no sacrifice this afternoon, Doctor. Or ever again."
"Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

"Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!"
—The Ninth Doctor
"I can see every single atom of your existence, and I divide them."
"Wilfred, it's my honor. Better be quick. Three, two, one."
"I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"
"You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"
